summary: Describes use cases for peering of non-VoIP services, such as presence and instant messaging, between two or more service providers. The aim is to drive requirements for peering so users in different providers can collaborate with each other. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Two chat companies want their users to message each other, like two phone companies connecting calls. This lists the situations where that would be useful, to help design how it should work.
